descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-22 Task Closure & Extraction · S15 Self-corrections make no task; conditional orders keep their condition and gain no route, frequency or urgency

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U5 A conditional order ('advance diet to clears if pain stays under 4') becomes a task (UAT TC-22; TFA-92592 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U6 A retraction ('leave glargine at 20') does not become a task (UAT TC-22; TFA-92592 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U10 Never invent, never drop: a task made from the dictation contains nothing that was not dictated (no added dose, route, frequency or urgency, no supplied decision) and keeps what was dictated, includi … (UAT 3.4; TFA-94229 R8; TFA-94229 R9) — gate: blocked: TFA-94229 in progress
  • U8 All of the above in Nursing Home as well as Hospital, passing in both (UAT TC-22 step 4; UAT 3.3; TFA-92592 AC 14) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Open task 'Recheck weight in two weeks'

When Save & Extract with each sentence alone, both contexts

Then E1 (glargine raised then taken back) and E2 (metolazone started then taken back): no task. E3: one potassium task keeping '40' and '3.5', with no unit, IV/PO or frequency added, not urgent. E4: one diet task keeping 'pain' and '4', not changed to full liquids/regular/NPO, not urgent

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): U6 as read in Q4; U5 + U10 (3.4: nothing added, including 'no guessed units on ambiguous values' — '40' was dictated without a unit; TFA-94229 R9: the condition is a dictated fact, Q6)

Where it ran: dev; test method AICHECK · AI output check; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)
